# dsh-knowledge-base-local
简体中文 | English
A local, model-readable knowledge-base plugin for **DeepSeek Harness** (DSH). It stores everything a
s plain Markdown you can open in any editor, and gives three independent ways in — agent tools, a CL
I, and a Web settings panel — plus PDF/Office text extraction, an MCP server for external clients, a
t-rest AES-256-GCM encryption and role-based multi-user access.
Three design goals:

1. **You own the location** — any absolute path, changeable at any time.
2. **Any model can read it*

* — Markdown *is* the data; no lock-in.
3. **Store anything** — text, Markdown, code, web pages, any
binary attachment; chunked and vectorised automatically.
> Zero runtime dependencies: Node built-ins only. Nothing to compile on install.

The chosen root and every preference live in the per-user data directory (default `~/.dsh`):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
That file is independent of the current workspace and profile, so your knowledge base follows you be
tween projects and is not lost when a profile changes.
## Features
- **Markdown as the source of truth** — each document is `docs/<id>.md` with frontmatter; a generate

d `CATALOG.md` gives models and humans a table of contents.
- **Six agent tools** — `kb_search`, `kb

_read`, `kb_list`, `kb_add`, `kb_import`, `kb_manage`.
- **Hybrid retrieval** — BM25 lexical + vecto

r cosine + title/substring bonus; results carry document id, line numbers and a snippet.
- **Three v
ector modes** — `local` (offline TF-IDF feature hashing), `llm` (model enrichment + local vectors),

`api` (OpenAI-compatible embeddings, falls back to local on failure).
- **Collections & tags** — nam

espace multiple knowledge bases; scope any query.
- **Trash & versions** — delete is soft (recoverab

le); every edit keeps a version (20 by default).
- **Inbox watcher** — files dropped into `<root>/in

box/` are imported automatically and updated on change (PDF/Office included).
- **URL import** — fet

ches readable page text (prefers Harness's `web` service).
- **PDF / Office text extraction** — `.pd

f` `.docx` `.xlsx` `.pptx`, zero dependencies. Details.
- **MCP server** — expose the library to Cla

ude Desktop, Cursor, or any MCP client over stdio or Streamable HTTP. Details.
- **At-rest encryptio
n** — AES-256-GCM per document; the passphrase only wraps a random data key via a scrypt-derived KEK

. Details.
- **Multi-user access** — `owner > admin > editor > reader`, per-collection narrowing, an
d SHA-256-hashed API tokens. Off by default (single-user). Details.
## Agent tools
| Tool | Purpose |

| `kb_search` | Hybrid retrieval; `collection`, `tags`, `limit`, `mode` |
| `kb_read` | Read a docum

ent in full, or by line range / chunk |
| `kb_list` | Browse documents, collections and stats |
| `k

b_add` | Store text / a local file / a URL; automatic de-duplication |
| `kb_import` | Recursively i

mport a folder or a single file/web page (runs PDF/Office extraction) |
[该节后续省略]
## Security model
- Writes are on by default; disable via the panel (Settings → Advanced → allow writing tools) or `to

ols.allowWrite: false`.
- Deletion is soft (`trash/`); only `purge` is permanent.
- All writes stay

inside the root; `kb_read` accepts only in-library ids/paths.
- `/kb-api` is same-origin by default;
cross-origin needs a Bearer token. `/kb-mcp` runs as the local role for same-origin web, tokens for

external processes.
- Passphrases and API keys never appear in `CATALOG.md`, `kb.json` or the index

; tokens are stored as SHA-256 hashes and shown once.
- A locked library refuses reads and writes ra
ther than returning ciphertext.
## Known limitations
- `local` vectors are lexical hashes, not embeddings; for paraphrase/semantic recall use `llm` or `a

pi`.
- In `api` mode the query also calls embeddings; if the endpoint is down, that search degrades

to lexical with a warning.
- Chunking follows paragraph/sentence boundaries; very long punctuation-f

ree runs are hard-cut.
- Versions keep bodies, not attachment history.
- No in-panel full-text edito

r (update via `kb_manage update`, or edit `docs/*.md` then `scan`).
- Scanned PDFs need OCR (out of

scope) and legacy `.doc/.xls/.ppt` are not parsed.
- Encryption has **no recovery**: a lost passphra

se means the corpus is unreadable forever; try the cycle on a small throwaway folder first.
- Metada
ta is plain by default (titles, tags, summaries, filenames, `CATALOG.md`); enable metadata encryptio

n to hide them, at the cost of direct browsing.
- RBAC is a same-machine identity layer, not tenant

isolation; use separate roots and system accounts per trust boundary.
- **Desktop app: the window re
jects external file drops.** In the DeepSeek Harness desktop shell an external file drag shows the "
no drop" cursor across the whole window and no `drop` event ever reaches the page, so the panel's dr
op zone cannot accept files — it already takes the drag over in the capture phase and sets `dropEffe
ct = 'copy'`, which is not enough because the rejection happens above the page. Use the **Browse…**
button in Import instead, copy files into `<root>/inbox/` for the watcher, or run `node kb.mjs impor
t <folder>`. A browser-served Web GUI, where the page owns the drag, may behave normally.
